title: Define the order cancellation policy
summary: Adds the domain transition and explicit outcomes for allowed and rejected cancellations.

nodes.description: Define the guarded cancellation transition and verify its domain outcomes.

rationale: The order aggregate owns the state transition so every caller applies the same fulfilment guard and receives a typed outcome.

decisions.summary: Put cancellation rules on the Order aggregate.
decisions.rationale: The transition depends only on current order state and must be enforced independently of the API.

decisions.summary: Treat any fulfilment state as non-cancellable.
decisions.rationale: Acceptance criterion reject-shipped forbids cancellation once fulfilment has started.

assumptions.statement: All states before Fulfilling are safe to cancel.
assumptions.riskIfWrong: A paid or reserved order may require compensation before cancellation.

alternatives.approach: Implement the guard only in the application command handler.
alternatives.reasonRejected: Other future callers could bypass the rule and create an invalid transition.

risks.summary: Future fulfilment states could make the current ordinal-style guard unsafe.
risks.mitigation: The implementation uses an explicit allow-list of cancellable states.

validation.summary: Covers successful cancellation, repeated cancellation, and rejection after fulfilment.

openQuestions.question: Should a paid but unfulfilled order trigger a refund in this story or a later one?
